headline: JSW Infrastructure: QIP of equity shares + OFS by Sajjan Jindal Family Trust under SEBI ICDR, 2018
sum: JSW Infrastructure announced a qualified institutions placement (QIP) of equity shares (face value ₹2 each) alongside an offer for sale (OFS) by promoter Sajjan Jindal Family Trust, structured under SEBI's Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2018 and Companies Act §42 & §62.
detail: The transaction combines two instruments: (1) a QIP of new equity by JSW Infrastructure to qualified institutional investors, and (2) a parallel OFS of existing equity held by Sajjan Jindal Family Trust (the promoter holding vehicle). The structure operates under SEBI's Chapter VI (qualified institutions placement) framework, allowing accelerated pricing and issue without prospectus. Both tranches leverage the Companies Act sections 42 (private placement) and 62 (preferential allotment) to streamline board approval and shareholder consent mechanisms.
